tei:div.tei:p: "$ (193)༄༅// zab mo nā ro'i chos drug gi nyams len thun chos bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi don khrid bzhugs so//

(194)༄༅// bla ma dang yi dam lhan cig skyes ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// dgongs pa dgrol pa dang rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ sgrub brgyud rin po che karma kaṃ tshang gi phyag bzhes rdzogs rim zab mo nā ro'i chos drug mdor bsdus te nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ len tshul sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las/ bla med bde dgyes lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par blangs pa sngon du song nas/ bsam gtan gyi tsher ma med pa'i gnas su/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs thun mong gi sngon 'gro la blo sbyang*/ sems can la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje bskyed pas rgyud bskul te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas rang gi spyi bor zla gdan gyi steng 'od kyi gur khang gi dbus su bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' 'od kyi sku can kha dog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzhugs pa la mos gus (195)dung byas pas/ de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'o ma lta bu byung*/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas rnam smin gyi phung po gdos bcas kyi cha sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa ltar song*/ lus phyi nang sgrib med shel gong phyis pa ltar gyur/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mos pa ngag tu/ spyi bor zla gdan 'od kyi gur khang dbus// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rab dkar ba// dal mos gus byas pas bdud rtsi babs// rnam smin lus sbyangs sdig sgrib dag par gyur// ces brjod pas gsal btab nas yi ge brgya pa mang du 'don/ mthar rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid la thim par mos te thun bsdu'o/ 1 /de nas byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/

rten med pa'i nam mkhar a haṃ zhes stong pa'i sgra grags pa'i rkyen gyis snod bcud zhu/ slar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das he ru ka sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu (196)'dzin pas yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum gyis 'khril ba la 'khyud pa ral pa'i thor tshugs rin po che dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan rin po che'i rtse bran can rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ g.yas brkyangs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khyud pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba'i klong na pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la gnas par bsam/ de nas rang gi lus las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad mchod pa'i lha mor gyur pas mchod par bsams nas/ de rnams gsal gdab pa'i phyir ngag tu/ mkha' las a haṃ stong pa'i sgra grags pas// rang nyid he ru kar gsal spyi gtsug na// bla ma yum bcas dgyes par bzhugs pa la// 'gro kun mchod lhar gyur pas mchod pa byas// zhes gsal btab nas ngag tu/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma'i drung*// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// 'gro tshogs sgo gsum longs spyod dang*// dge tshogs 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs dang*// stong chen rtogs par byed pa'i ro// dri chu dri chen rak+ta dang*// khu klad bde chen 'bar ba'i ro// mi rta khyi ba glang po'i sha/ ye shes bdud rtsir dag pa can// dpal ldan bla ma mchog la 'bul// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// mchod lha bla ma'i yum la thim// yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba yis// gsal ba bde stong mchod pas dgyes// mtshar sdug 'od du 'bar bar gyur// ces 'don bsgom byas nas/

dbang bskur ba'i don du/ e ma ho e ma ho chos/ e ma ho chos kyi don 'byung ba// chos (197)don dag pa bdag med pa// rdo rje rgyal por phyag 'tshal 'dud// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas// bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug gi sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te/ 'dus pa bla ma'i thugs kar zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros te yum gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad mchod slar rdo rje bung bas yum gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad bdud rtsi'i ngo bor bzhus pa'i sbrang rtsi legs par btung ba sbyor mtshams nas babs/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas zhugs te rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar khyab par spros pas bum dbang thob/ rtsa dag pa sku rdo rje mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi'i chu zhabs yar 'khyil bas bla ma yab yum sngar bas mtshar sdug 'od du chags par gyur/ de nas bla ma yab yum 'o byed pa dang*/ 'khyud pa dang*/ dku rtsa 'tshir ba dang*/ rdo rje dang pad+ma drag tu srub pa'i sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar chu bo'i rgyun lta bu byung*/ bdag nyid kyi lce rdo rje rtse gsum pa nas byon/ mgrin pa'i yi ge ya ra la wa nas brgyud rlung bcus bsdus pa'i nyi khri chig stong gi bar khyab par spros pas gsang dbang thob/ rlung dag pa gsung rdo rje mngon du byas/ de nas bla ma'i yum las phag mo gnyis pa chad/ bdag nyid he ru kar gnas pa'i yum la thim/ he ru ka yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas byang sems spyi gtsug nas mgrin pa'i bar babs pas dga' ba/ de nas rdo rjes pad+ma dpyis phyin par phug pas byang sems snying gar babs pas mchog dga'/ de nas 'og rlung bsdams pas 'dzag pa bcing zhing byang sems lte bar bab pas khyad dga'/ de nas rdo rjes dal bus pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru (198)legs par 'jibs pas khams dwangs ma zhu ba 'dzin zhing byang sems gsang ba'i rtse mo'i bar khyab par spros pas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba myong*/

shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thig le dag pa thugs rdo rje mngon du byas/ de nas bdag nyid kyi rgyud la skyes pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes chos nyid brjod med rtog bral gyi myong ba dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes gnyis spros bral ro gcig tu bsre/ lam gyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'bras bu mi rtog ye shes kyi ngo bor brgyud/ brtan g.yo'i ye shes kyi bar khyab par spros pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ rnam shes dag pa bde chen gyi sku mngon du byas/ de nas bla ma yab yum gyis rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig spyi bo dang snying gar brtan/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig mgrin pa dang gsang bar brtan/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig dbu ma rnam dag tu brtan pas rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang thob/ phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub pa la 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du sdod pa'i nga rgyal phyog nas/ de rnams gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ ngag tu/ bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug bdud rtsi yis// rtsa gang byang sems rgyun gyis rlung rnams sbyangs// mnyam sbyor dga' bzhi myong nas chos nyid rtogs// dam tshig gsum brtan dbang thob slob dpon gyur// zhes brjod pas gsal gdab cing bsgoms nas/ skye ba kun tu rigs bdag mi 'chol zhing*// bcom ldan drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin bzhin du// shes rab pad+ma'i bdud rtsi 'thung byed cing*// byang chub snying por srid pa dag bgyid shog /ces smon lam bya'o// de dag ni sbyor ba'am sngon 'gro'i man ngag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gtum mo sogs drug las/ dang po la/ ma zin pa zin par byed pa/ zin pa brtan par byed pa/ brtan pa (199)bogs dbyung ba gsum gyi dang po la/ thog mar stong ra sbyang ba ni/ lus gnad bde ba'i stan la rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol/

lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bcing*/ sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang ste/ lag pa'i gru mo nang du phul/ dpung pa'i 'phel ka phyir bskyed pa'i gnad kyis dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyang*/ mgrin pa yid tsam dgug /mig sna rtser gtad/ lce mchu rang bab tu bzhag /lus bsrang ba'i phyir sgom thag gus 'og nas drangs te phrag pa la bkon nas/ bla ma la mos gus kyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khams gsum po'i snod bcud thams cad ye shes kyi 'khor lo rten pa rten par gyur pa'i dbus na bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo lang tsho rgyas pa sku'i gnas mtho ba rnams rgya skyegs kyis kha bkug pa ltar smug pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas kyis gri gug phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag bcas 'dzin pa/ he ru ka'i ngo bo'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gru mor brten pa/ dbu skra sum cha bcings shing lhag ma grol ba/ mi mgo'i phreng ba se ral khar byas pa/ nu ma dang bha ga rgyas shing sbed pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su pad nyi dang ro ser po'i steng du gar stabs kyis rol pa'i sku'i nang gsal dwangs rnyogs pa dang bral ba nam mkha'i ngos la stong pa'i ri mos bar ma chod pa ltar dmigs te/ ngag tu/ rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi sku// dmar la smug pa'i mdangs chags gri thod 'dzin// bha ga nu ma rab rgyas gar stabs can// gsal dwangs rnyogs pa kun dang bral ba'o// zhes 'don bsgom bya'o/ 3 /de ltar snang brnyan gyi sku sgrub pa'i phyir stong ra legs par bsgoms nas/ da ni rigs ldan gyi gzhi gzung ba rtsa sbyang ba ni lus gnad gong (200)ltar la dmigs pa'ang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gong ltar bskyed pa'i sku'i nang gi dbus su rtsa dbu ma sngon po shin tu drangs pa/

mar sna sna tshogs rdo rje'i rtsibs can gyi 'khor los spras pa'i tshangs bug gi bar dang*/ mar sna gsang ba'i pad+mar ze'u 'bru'i tshul du gnas pa gro sog 'bring po tsam pa/ g.yas ro ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon brkyang ma dkar mo gnyis kyang dbu ma'i rang tshad dang mnyam pa gro sog phra shos tsam pa/ gsum ga'ang gcig la gcig ma reg pa khang stong du ka ba btsug pa lta bu bsam mo// long skabs che ba dang dmigs pa zin dka' ba la 'dir thun gcig byed pa dam gnyan du ma byas kyang rung*/ mchan/ de nas lte ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab re bzhi dmar po kha gyen bstan gru gsum e yig gi dbyibs can/ snying ga'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kha 'og bstan dkar po zlum po waṃ yig gi dbyibs can/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug dmar po kha gyen bstan gru gsum e yig gi dbyibs can/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis kha 'og bstan dkar po zlum po waṃ yig gi dbyibs can/ de rnams kyi rtsa sne g.yogs bcas sgrib med phra sbom ro rkyang dang ma 'brel bar bsgoms te/ de gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ ngag tu/ lus kyi nang dbus dhū ti mthing gsal drang*// gsang ba'i gnas nas tshangs pa'i yul sar sleb// ro rkyang de tshad dmar dang dkar ba'i mdog /'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa shin tu gsal// zhes 'don bsgom bya/ 4 de nas rlung sbyang ba'i phyir sna bug gnyis nas rlung rang 'gros dran rtsol cung zad che tsam gyis nang du bsdus nas rdzogs pa'i mod de nyid du/ thog mar dal tsam la de nas shugs drag pos rlung lhag ma ma lus par sangs kyis bus/ rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar te de'i dus/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sna bug gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang lus kyi ba spu'i bu (201)ga thams cad khrol tshags ltar sing nge yod pa nas thon pas sangs kyis dag /lus shin tu dag pa me shel dri ma med pa lta bu la sems bzhag

/de nas yang dal la ring bar brngubs te mchil ma zhig mid pa dang mnyam du lte bar mnan/ srin zhal nang du sdom pa'i tshul gyis 'og rlung 'then nas/ steng 'og gi rlung lhan cig lto ba'i smad cha ther byas la dgang*/ gnon mi bde can lte bar hri la byas pa de lus kyi nang rang gnas su cung zad lhod byas la/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sngo sib sib song bar bsams nas gzhil/ gnon mi thub snyam tsa na/ spyi gtsug nas sngo sangs sangs song bar sgom pa spyi gtsug mda' ltar 'phang ba ste thun mgo la re re tsam byed cing*/ gzhan sna bug nas sangs bus te spos reng gi dud pa lta bur phyir thon/ sor bcu drug tsam gyi nam mkha' la yal bar bsam/ yang sdud dus 'od kyi skud pa 'dra ba'i rlung sor bcu drug gi thad kyi nam mkha' rang las byung*/ nang du snying ga'i thad kyi dbu mar thim par bsam/ phyi ma 'di la rang bzhin mda' ltar 'phang ba'ang zer/ yang gong gi gzhil ba'i skabs su nang gzhil byed na/ ro rkyang gi rlung dhū tir bcug /yur ba las chu drang ba lta bur lte snying gi bar gyi thad tsam du sleb pa dang yal bar bsams nas/ dbu ma'i nang stong sang nge ba la sems gtad/ 'di ni gzhil tshul mchog yin yang*/ las dang po pa la rlung khug ring ba la ni snga ma phan gi 'dug cing*/ bugs kyi yon tan 'og ma 'di che ste/ de ltar rngub dgang gzhi la mda' ltar 'phang ba bzhi po la sbyor ba bzhi ldan zhes zer zhing*/ 'dir 'don sgom sbrags pa mi bde yang*/ yid yul du gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ rlung ro bsal bas sdig sgrib nad gdon dag /dal bar brngubs te steng 'og kha sbyar dgang*// gnon par mi bde tshe na gzhil ba dang*// mi non pa na (202)mda' ltar 'phang ba'o// zhes pa'i don nges par sbyang ste/ de la gsang gsum gyi 'gros sbyang ba rlung sbyang ba zhes tha snyad mdzad do// de nas chu zla'i gar bsgyur ba thig le sbyang ba ni/

stong ra rtsa gsal gdab pa la sogs sngon bzhin la dbu ma'i yar sna tshangs bug nas smin mtshams kyi bar sne bsrings te gnas pa'i smin mtshams su rus pa gru gsum gyi nang dbu ma'i rtsa sner rlung sems kyi ngo bo thig le dkar la 'tsher ba snum la 'dril ba bde ba dang ldan pa zhig bsgom zhing rlung sbyor dang ldan pas gsal btab/ gsal thebs pa dang*/ rang bzhin mda' ltar 'phang pa'i sbyor ba dang bstun/ thig le tshangs bug gi thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du sing sgra dang bcas shing*/ bde ba'i tshor ba dang ldan par song nas/ der gnas pa la sems gzhag /yang rngub pa'i sbyor ba dang bstun nas/ thig le dbu ma'i nang du mar byung dgang ba dang bstun/ gsang ba'i rtse mor bde phri le gnas par bsgom/ yang rang bzhin mda' ltar 'phang ba dang bstun spyi gtsug tu song*/ rngub pa dang bstun/ smin mtshams su gnas par bsam/ de ltar 'khor mar sbyang zhing thun 'jog pa'i tshe smin mtshams su thig le bsdus nas 'jog ste/ de nyid gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ smin mtshams thig le dkar 'tsher snum la 'dril// rang bzhin mda' ltar 'phang bas spyi bor bkod// brngubs pas dhū ti'i lam nas gsang bar sleb// de ltar 'byung ldog byas pas bde ba skyes// zhes gsal btab nas nyams su blang*/ 6 de ltar ma zin pa zin byed kyi thabs bstan nas/ gnyis pa zin pa brtan par byed pa la lus gnad sngar ltar rlung sbyang yan chad sngon du btang*/ rang nyid kyi lus lha sku gsal dwangs su gong ltar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang du rtsa gsum legs par gsal btab pa'i lte 'og sor bzhi tsam man chad gsum (203)gnad gcig tu gyur ba'i lte ba'i 'og gsang ba'i steng rgyu zhabs gnyer mtshams kyi thad kyi dhū ti'i nang du me'i chos 'byung gi dbus su ye shes kyi gtum mo thig le'i rnam pa kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ ngo bo mi dmigs pa/ rnam pa bde ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan tsan ka'i 'bras bu'i tshad tsam/

ches shin tu phra ba zhig bsam nas bum can gyi sbyor ba byas pas me shed skyes shing*/ bde ba dang ldan par bsgom/ de la sems zin pa dang*/ rlung sbyor gyis mi shed je cher bskyed nas/ sran ma'i rdog po tsam pa/ gcan gzan gyi spu tsam gyi rtse mo sum 'khyog tu yod pa la sems gtad/ de la brtan nas kha ba tsam pa sum 'khyog skad cig kyang mi sdod par g.yo ba dang*/ de 'dra ba sor gnyis dang*/ bzhi tsam pa la sems sbyang ste/ thig le'i rtags yod pa 'di rnams thun so so'am dmigs thun bdun par bsdus kyang rung ngo*// me de dag kyang dmar ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi ldan rtsa ba sbom la brtan pa/ rtse mo phra zhing g.yo ba/ dhū ti'i nang du nyug nyug pa la sems gzung ngo*// 'khrul 'khor drug pa bya ste/ sked pa g.yas skor g.yon skor gyis// lte ba'i rtsa mdud 'grol ba yin// ro stod g.yas g.yon gcud pa yis// snying ga'i rtsa mdud 'grol ba yin// mgrin pa bskor zhing dgye dgu yis// spyi bo mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud 'grol// rkang lag brkyang bskum byas pa yis// tshigs kyi rtsa mdud 'grol ba yin// lus sprugs phur bsrub byas pa yis// rtsa rnams thams cad 'dul ba yin// zhes so// dmigs pa de dag gsal gdab pa'i phyir// rtsa gsum 'dus mdor me yi chos 'byung dbus// ye shes gtum mo thig le shin tu phra/ 'dir/ ye shes gtum mo rno ldan sran ma tsam/ zhes dang*/ ye shes gtum mo gsum 'khyog mo khab tsam/ zhes dang*/ ye (204)shes gtum mo gsum 'khyog sor gnyis pa/ zhes dang*/ ye shes gtum mo gsum 'khyog sor bzhi ba/ zhes dmigs pa dang bstun nas 'don pa bsgyur// kha dog dmar la reg bya rab tu tsha// ngo bo stong nyid rnam pa bde zhing gsal// zhes gsal gdab cing bsgom// de ni zin pa brtan byed kyi man ngag go /gsum pa brtan pa bogs dbyung ba la/ drod kyi bogs dbyung ba/

bde ba'i bogs dbyung ba/ mi rtog pa'i bogs dbyung ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ de ltar gong du bstan pa rnams bsgoms kyang mi dmigs sogs mi gsal ba'am/ gsal yang bogs dbyung ba'i phyir/ lus gnad sngar ltar ram/ yang na rkang pa'i long bu gnyis bsnol la pus mo so sor basprad/ lag gnyis bsnol ba'i gru mo pus steng du btsug /lag mthil dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng du sbyar te/ pus 'khyud kyis bcings pas rkang pa la thab 'gal gu gsum gnyis/ lag pa la bzhi ste drug /nang dang gsang ba'i yang da ltar drug yod pas thab 'gal gyi phyag rgya bco brgyad bca'/ dmigs pa'i gnad rang nyid lha sku gsal dwangs/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa sngar ltar la/ gtsug tor gyi sar rtsa gsum yar sne bsrings pa'i rtse mor gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab dgu pa/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa/ tshigs chen gyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis la rtsa 'dab brgyad re/ tshigs phan gyi 'khor lo rnams la rtsa 'dab bzhi re yod par bsgoms pa'i rtsa gsum 'dus mdor ye shes kyi gtum mo thig le'i rnam pa gsal zhing 'bar ba'i rtse mo dhū ti'i nang du zhugs par bsam zhing rlung sbyor gyis gnad du bsnun pas de las me drag tu 'bar/ lte ba'i 'khor lo man chad khyab par bsgom/ drug skor gyi pho ba g.yas skor g.yon skor bya/ de brtan nas snying ga man chad khyab par bsgom/ ro stod g.yas g.yon gcud (205)par bya/ de brtan nas mgrin pa dang spyi bo man chad khyab par bsgom/ mgrin pa bskor zhing dgye dgu bya/ de brtan nas yan lag gi 'khor lo rnams khyab par bsgom/ yan lag brkyang bskum bya/ de brtan nas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis sogs ba spu'i mthar thug par khyab par bsgom/ lus sprug phur bsrub bya/ de ltar ye shes kyi me 'bar bas 'khor ba'i rten byed pa'i rtsa rnams dang rtsa mdud brten par byed pa'i cha thams cad bsregs/

mchog gi dbu ma ma gtogs phyi 'khor ba'i srog gi rten byed pa'i dbu ma'ang bsregs par mos te/ gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug dang 'khor phran bcas// gsal ba'i 'dus mdo'i gtum mo rab tu 'bar// gtso mo gsum gang 'khor lo rnams kyang gang*// ba spu'i bar khyab slar yang 'dus mdor bsdus// zhes thun mthar 'dus mdo'i gzhi'i gtum mo la me rnams bsdus te mnyam par gzhag /skabs 'dir bogs 'don gyi lus sbyang so bdun ma bya ba ni/ sa non byas la pho ba ni// g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor bas drug /pus mo g.yas par 'jus nas ni// de bzhin drug dang g.yon la'ang drug /mthe bos srin rtsa mnan nas kyang*// g.yas g.yon khu tshur zhag 'phen drug /g.yas g.yon mda' 'gengs byed pa drug /g.yas g.yon lag pa'i nang shad drug /lus kun sprug dang so bdun no// zhes pa ltar ro// de nas bde ba'i bogs dbyung ba'i phyir// lus gnad dang stong ra rtsa 'khor snga ma ltar gsal ba'i bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus dhū ti'i nang du bdud rtsi zla ba byang chub kyi sems dkar cha'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dri ma dang bral ba lta bu'i lte bar haṃ yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ lte 'khor gyi dbus bhū ti'i nang du tsaṇ+ḍa lī phra zhing phra ba gong bu'i rnam pa mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gsal ba la rlung sbyor gyis gnad (206)du bsnun pas/ de las sor gang lhag tsam gyi me 'bar bas de'i reg pas spyi bo'i haṃ yig zla ba dang bcas pa g.yos haṃ yig las byang chub kyi sems haṃ yig mgo thur bstan gyi rnam par 'jag par rtsom pa na/ yang rlung rab tu dgang zhing me sor gnyis tsam du 'bar bas byang sems haṃ yig mgo thur bstan gyi rnam par zag pa de nyid byang thig dkar po nyungs kar tsam par byas te/ chab rom las thigs pa zag pa bzhin dhū ti'i nang nas brgyud de mgrin pa'i bar babs/ de nas snying ga nas me sor brgyad tsam 'bar bas thig le mar babs nas de dang gtum mo gnyis med du 'dres ma thag thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i byang thig gis lus thams cad gang bar bsam zhing sems gzung bde ba skyes pa dang rtog med du cham gyis bzhag ste/

ngag tu/ rlung gi sbyor bas gtum mo sbar ba'i mthus// spyi bo'i zla ba haṃ yig bcas pa las// dkar cha 'dzag pa thig le'i gzugs su byon// dkar dmar 'dres pa'i thig les lus kun gang*// dga' dang bde dang sim pa skyed par gyur// ces brjod de bsgom mo// yang 'bros 'ded kyi dmigs pa ni/ gzhan sngar ltar la rlung sbyor byas pas gtum mo las me dbu ma'i nang du yar nar gyis song*/ haṃ yig la reg ma thag thig le dmar pos lus thams cad gang ba de mer gyis gyur/ slar haṃ yig las thig le dkar po chad/ me lce la reg pas me lce de je dmar song nas sor bzhi tsam du gnas pa'i tshe lus thams cad byang thig dkar pos gang bas bde ba rgyas par bsams la/ ngag tu/ rlung gi sbyor bas gtum mo nar gyis 'bar// haṃ la reg 'phal thig le dmar pos gang*// haṃ las thig le chad pas me phyir log /lus kun thig le dkar pos gang bar gyur// ces bsgom mo/ 10 des kyang bde ba rab tshad du ma skyes na ba 'jo'i dmigs pa ni/ pus mo gnyis sbyar zhing rkang (207)mgo phyir bskyed spyi bo'i haṃ las dkar cha'i rang bzhin hūm̐ dkar po zhig bde phril gyis dbu ma'i nang nas mar chad/ gsang ba'i rtse mor bde phril ler gnas par bsam zhing 'og rlung 'then 'phul bya/ bde ba mi thub pa snyam tsa na hūm̐ de spyi gtsug tu rgyangs kyis song haṃ la thim tshangs bug rdo rje dkar po rtse lngar rgya gram gyis bkag par bsam la/ rtog med du gzhag /ngag tu/ spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po zag /dhū ti'i lam brgyud gsang ba'i rtse mor gnas// bde ba rab rgyas slar yang steng du song*// haṃ la thim zhing tshangs bug rdo rjes bkag /ces bsgom/ 11 de nas mi rtog pa'i bogs dbyung ba'i phyir// lus gnad spang la pe phur btab pa bzhin mi g.yo bar bca'/ lta stongs nam mkha'i dbyings su mi g.yo bar blta/ 'jam rlung cung zad bzung la bde ba'i rtog pa'am dro ba'i rtog pa'am/

mdor na yid kyi yul du rnam par rtog pa gang shar ba de ka'i ngo bo la bcos bslad med par mnyam par gzhag /thib tshang du 'jug pa ltar chon ne gzhag /sbrang ma gar sbyin la 'byar ba ltar mi g.yo ba lhan ne gzhag /bya ba zin pa'i skyes bu ltar rtsol sgrub med par gzhag /sog phon mdud pa bshig pa ltar glod la gzhag /de ltar bzhag pas yang rnam rtog gcig skyes na de'i ngo bo la sngar ltar cer gyis bltas te gzhag go /chu rnyogs ma dang bral ba lta bur dwangs sang nge ba/ de rlabs kyis ma bskyod pa lta bu lhan ne bar gzhag /ngag tu/ gnyug ma'i shes pa gsal dwangs rnyogs pa med// ngos gzung med cing 'phrog nas 'gro 'ong med// bcas bcos byar med rang gar glod la gzhag /glod pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu'o// zhes bsgom mo/ 12 de ltar brtan pa bogs dbyung ba'i yan lag ste/ de rnams kyis gtum mo'i nyams len gyi thun dmigs (208)smos zin to/ ༈ /gnyis pa sgyu lus nyams su blang ba lam dag pa sbyang ba dang*/ dag pa sbyang ba dang*/ thun mong min pa sbyong ba gsum/ dang po la/ ma zin pa zin byed sogs gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad sngar bzhin rnam snang gi chos bdun bca'/ yul gnad snang ba sna tshogs/ dus gnad nyin par shas che/ dmigs pa la dang por 'dus byas kyi chos rnams mi rtag /sgos su 'gro ba'i tshe srog mi rtag /bu dang chung ma gnyen nor rdzas sogs kyang snying po med de/ mdor na chos shig ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi 'tshengs mi phan/ skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi/ bsags pa'i tha ma 'dzad/ 'grogs pa'i tha ma 'bral/ mdza' ba'i tha ma 'khon/ gsos pa'i lus ni 'jig /rgyu ba'i dbugs ni chad/ nye 'brel shul du lus/ nor rdzas gzhan gyis spyod/ phung po ro ru song*/ rang dbang rang la med/ mdor na gang la'ang snying po med// cis kyang dgos pa med snyam du bsam zhing skyo ba bskyed pas blo sbyong ba sngon du btang nas/

'di snyam du gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di thams cad de snga bden par bzung bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin par 'dug /'di thams cad brtags shing dpyad na med bzhin du snang ba rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rkyen las byung ba brag cha dang rnga'i sgra lta bu mi rtag pa glog dang chu bur lta bu/ snang yang rang bzhin med pa smig rgyu dang chu zla lta bu'o// snyam du legs par bsgoms te/ ngag tu/ gzugs sgra dri ro rta glang khang khyim sogs// snang ba 'di kun med bzhin snang ba ste// rkyen las byung zhing mi rtag rang bzhin med// rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bden pas stong*// zhes 'don sgom bya zhing mnyam rjes thams cad du de ltar bsam/ 1 gnyis pa zin pa brtan byed/ rang gi gzugs me long la 'char du bcug ste/ de la rgyan btags pa rdeg 'tshog byas pa/ bstod smad byas pa khyad med pa (209)ltar// rang gi lus kyang de dang 'dra// ngag brag cha dang 'dra/ yid rtog smig rgyu la chur 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ me long gzugs brnyan 'di la dga' dang gdung*// mdzes dang mi mdzes snyan dang mi snyan med// rang gi lus kyang de dang 'dra ba ste// ngag dang yid kyang brag cha smig rgyu bzhin// zhes 'don sgom bya/ 2 gsum pa bogs dbyung ba ni/ de ltar byas pas rang la bstod smad kyi dga' gdung sogs mgo non zhing brtan pa ni/ thog mar bla ma'am mched grogs lta bu rgyus yod pa zhig la bstod smad sna tshogs byed du bcug /de nas tshong dus sogs skye bo mang po'i sar song nas spyod pa mtho dman sna tshogs shig byas pas/ mi gzhan gyis bstod smad deg 'tshog dga' mi dga' sogs byed pa la khyad par e 'dug pa lta/ 'dug na slar yang dben par song la bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba drag tu gdab cing slar yang bsgoms te/ mtshams su gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ skyes pa bud med 'di kun rmi lam bzhin// bstod dang smad pa'i tshig 'di brag cha bzhin// mthong thos myong ba'i sems 'di ri dwags kyis// smig rgyu chu ru 'khrul dang mi mtshungs sam// zhes 'don sgom bya'o/

3 /gnyis pa dag pa ni/ me long gi nang du yi dam gyi sku'i gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ de ci 'dra ba bzhin du rang gi lus kyang lha sku stong zhing rang bzhin med pa/ snang yang bden par ma grub pa yin la/ sems can thams cad kyang lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ba' zhig yin/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyang gzhal yas kyi khang pa snang la rang bzhin med pa/ ngag sngags kyi sgra brag cha lta bu/ yid g.yo ba smig rgyu tsam 'di bde ba chen po rang grol yin pas/ gnas gzhal yas khang la skyid mi skyid/ bcud lha sku la chags sdang dang bstod smad/ sngags kyi sgra la dga' gdung 'byung ba'i yul ci la yod/ ces bsam zhing*/ (210)ngag tu/ rang lus la sogs gzugs snang 'di thams cad// lha sku snang stong zung 'jug gzugs brnyan ltar// des na chags sdang bstod smad dga' gdung gi// rtog pa skye ba'i yul de gang du song*// zhes 'don sgom bya/ 4 sgyu lus kyi dmigs pa 'di dag la/ rgyas par ni gong du zin pa brtan byed kyi skabs su lus gzugs brnyan ltar sgom pa la thun gcig /brag cha yod pa'i sar song nas ngag brag cha ltar sgom pa la thun gcig /smig rgyu yod pa'i sar song nas yid smig rgyu ltar sgom pa la thun gcig ste gsum byas pas yongs sgril drug gam/ 'di ka ltar bzhi byas pas kyang don 'thus/ gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa shin tu phra ba'i rlung thig sgyu lus kyi skur sgrub pa 'di/ gser zhun rtsa bar sgas don du mdzad kyang*/ rje brgyad pa'i dgongs pas gnyis/ dngos po dang*/ sgogs chog go /dang po ni/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dben gsum gyis// gnyug ma'i sgo gsum bcos bslad med par gzhag /rlung sems zin pas snang gsum lugs 'byung las// lugs ldog sgyu ma'i sku ru ldang bar bya// zhes gsal btab nas rkang pa rdor gdan sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang*/ mig 'byed 'dzum gyi spros pa med par hrig ge blta/

dbugs dbyung rngub med par ngag gsung ba yang ma yin mi gsung ba yang ma yin/ lce mchu ma 'byar ba rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rdor bzlas/ lag pa mnyam gzhag mi g.yo/ mdor na rang bzhin lhun grub kyi lus rnam par dben pa g.yo med rang sor bzhag /de'i ngang nas rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sems dben/ dus gsum gyi yid byed thams cad cham gyis gzhag /yod med stong mi stong bsgom bya sgom byed sgom mi sgom sogs cir yang mi sems par bzhag /de'i ngang nas rnam rtog gi 'char sgo byung na mu mthud du mi gzhug par rtog pa kha rgyu 'og rgyu thams cad rtog med yengs med du gzung*/ bying rmugs byung na lta stangs (211)stong rig pa dar phyung*/ 'phro rgod byung na lta stangs smad/ shes pa khong glod bying rgod med na mnyam par bskyang*/ de yang thun mgo la bzang zhing thun gsham la ngan nam/ snga thun la bzang zhing phyi thun la ngan na/ chu zad pa'i rdzing ltar khams gtugs pa yin pas khams gso zhing shes pa glod nas bsgom/ thun mgo la ngan zhing thun gsham la bzang ngam/ snga thun la ngan zhing phyi thun la bzang na/ yur bas rdzing gi chu ma 'drongs pa ltar sbyor rtsol ba chung ba yin pas hur bton te bsgom/ de ltar sgom zhing bla ma la chos sku'i mos gus bya/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi lus longs spyod bdog pa thams cad phul cing mchod pas byin rlabs kyi mthu dang*/ nyams len gyi stobs kyis phyag chen du sems zin/ de zin pas rlung zin/ de las nyams skye ste/ sa chu la thim pas smig rgyu 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa sngo mer mer ba dang*/ sngo hrib hrib pa dang chu g.yo ba'i rnam pa lta bu 'byung*/ chu me la thim pas du ba lta bu phyur ba dang du thang chags pa lta bu 'byung*/ me rlung la thim pas srin bu me khyer lta bu dmar tsheg tsheg pa dang dmar phra phra ba 'byung*/ rlung sems la thim pas mar me lta bu 'byung*/

sems sems byung la thim pa'i dus su zla ba'i snang ba lta bu/ sems byung ma rig pa la thim pa'i dus su nyi ma lta bu/ ma rig pa thams cad stong par thim pa'i dus su sgra gcan nam mun nag lta bu/ de'i dus su thams cad stong pa sprin med pa'i nam mkha'

chos sku yin gsungs lta bu 'char/ de nas snang gsum lugs ldog tu 'char te/ thams cad stong pa las ma rig pa/ de las sems byung*/ de las sems/ sems gsum rlung dang bcas pa las sgyu ma'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu/ gnyis kyis mtshon par byas pa so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi ngor mngon gsum sprul sku yin gsungs/ du 'char (212)la/ der ma zad dus gsum gyi brtan g.yo dag pa'i snang ba dang ma dag pa khams gsum pa thams cad kyang sgrib pa dang bral bar skyu ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar mthong ba snyam byed de/ 'di ni dben gsum rang sor bzhag pa las skyes pa'i sgyu lus sgom tshul mdor bsdus pa'o// 'di phyag rgya dang po gsum gyis sgrub pa'i tshul sogs yod kyang ma smos so/ 5 gnyis pa spogs chog ni/ de ltar bsgoms kyang nyams ma skyes pa'am/ stong pa las sgyu ma'i sku 'grub pa mi 'thad snyam na/ yid ches par bya ba'i phyir// mun khang dang*/ rgya skyegs kyi chu dang*/ ral gri dang*/ me long gi sbyor bas spogs chog bya ste/ zhib par rlung sems gnyis med la sogs pa'i man ngag tu gsal bas rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhabs kyi pad+mar bsnyen nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ ༈ /gsum pa rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs kyi gdams pa la gsum/ gzung ba/ skyang ba/ de kho na nyid sgom pa'o// dang po la nyin par dran pa rgyun chags bya ba dang*/ mtshan mo gdams ngag btsan thabs kyis gzung ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad la/ 'khor ba'i bya ba la snying po med par bsam/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yin pa la/ de ltar ma shes pas ma rgan sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin ang snyam du snying rje chen po bskyed/ spyod lam rnam bzhi thams cad du'ang*/ e ma snang ba 'di thams cad sgyu ma lta bu rmi lam lta bu yin/ de yin pa la yin par bdag gis shes par bya/

khyad par do nub rmi lam rmi bar bya/ de rmi lam du ngo shes par bya snyam du dran 'dun yang yang btang ngo*/ 1 gnyis pa ni/ stan bde ba la seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis 'dug nas nyal khar bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ mos gus drag tu bya/ gsol ba snying thag pa nas gdab ste/ rje skyabs gsum gyi ngo bo bla (213)rje// pha rtogs ldan gyi rgyal po dgongs su gsol// gnyid 'od gsal du thim par byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam sgyu lus su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba lan mang du btab/ do nub gnyid 'od gsal du 'dzin/ rmi lam sgyu lus su ldang*/ de'i ldang gzhi rmi lam yang mang po rmi zhing gsal por rmi bar bya'o// bzang por rmi bar bya'o// cis kyang rmi lam zin par bya// rmi lam rmi lam du ngo shes par bya// zhes 'dun pa drag tu btang*/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gtum mo'i skabs ltar gsal ba'i mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa ze'u 'bru dang bcas pa'i dbus su oṃ dkar po/ mdun du a sngon po/ g.yas su nu ser po/ rgyab tu ta dmar po/ g.yon du ra ljang gu rnams gsal bar bsgoms nas/ ngag tu/ bdag gis rmi lam cis kyang zin par bya// rmi lam rmi lam yin par shes par bya// mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng*// oṃ dang a nu ta ra'i yi ge lnga// dkar sngo ser dang dmar ljang mdog can gsal// zhes thog mar spyir gsal btab cing*// de'i nang nas a la sems gzung*/ de nas gnyid 'od 'dod pa dang nu la/ de nas gnyid zi ba dang ta la/ de nas gnyid phri ba dang ra la/ de nas oṃ la sems bzung nas gnyid 'thug 'od gsal la bzhag pas rmi lam 'char ba dang bstun nas zin 'ong bas rmi lam lha skur bsgom pa sogs ci zin bya'o// lan dang por ma zin kyang rmi lam 'di 'dun pa rang gtso bas 'dun pa drag tu btang*/ bla ma mkha' 'gro la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab cing bskyar bas zin no/

2 gnyis pa sbyang ba la/ spel bsgyur la sbyang ba/ sgyu mar spang ba/ sgyu ma'i rnam thar la sbyang ba'o// dang po ni/ rmi lam zin pa kho nas mi chog pas// bdag gis do nub rmi lam zin zhing zin nas kyang gcig las du ma sogs spel ba dang*/ ngan pa las bzang po dang*/ (214)lha skur bsgyur ba sogs bya'o snyam du 'dun pa btang la nyal/ rmi lam zin pa dang*/ rmi lam bden par ma grub ce byas btub snyam pas/ rang mir 'dug pa mkha' lding du sgyur ba sogs dang*/ ngan pa rmis pa bzang por sgyur ba dang*/ rang lus lha sku sgyu mar bsgom zhing bde dgyes sogs gang 'dod du sgyur ba dang*/ zhal phyag sogs tha dad pa mang po dang*/ gcig las du ma dang du ma las gcig tu sprul zhing sgyur ba la sbyang ngo*// de ltar sbyang ba'i phyir gnyid khar gsal gdab pa ni/ rmi lam bden par ma grub sgyu ma nyid// des na bdag gis rmi lam bzung nas kyang*// gcig dang du ma lha sku sna tshogs sogs// gang 'dod sprul sgyur gtan la dbab par bya// zhes 'dun pa gsal btab ste bya'o/ 3/gnyis pa ni/ rmi lam du me dang*/ chu chen po dang*/ g.yang sa dang*/ dgra dang*/ gcan gzan sogs 'jigs pa'i rnam pa mthong na de la yang spang zhing sgyu mar sbyang dgos pas rmi lam ni med bzhin snang ba bden par ma grub pa yin na/ de'i mes su 'tshig /chus su 'khyer/ dgras su la gnod pa byed/ gcan gzan gyis su zhig za/ g.yang du su zhig lhung ste/ bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma lta bu yin pas bdag gis rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad la sgyu mar shes pas ya nga ba spang zhing sbyang ngo snyam du 'dun pa btang*/ ngag tu/ rmi lam yul snang me chu dug mtshon sogs// thams cad de dang de ru grub pa med// thams cad sgyu ma nyid de bden pas stong*// de phyir bdag gis ya nga 'jigs pa spang*// zhes gsal btab nas nyal te zin pa dang me lta bu rmis na/ rmi lam gyi mes su 'tshig snyam du thog brdzis bya/

chu la'ang gom pa spo zhing 'gro/ rmi lam gyi g.yang la su zhig 'brul snyam du bya ltar lding zhing 'phur ba sogs bya'o/ 4 /gsum pa la/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam thar la bslab pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam thar la bslab pa gnyis/ (215)dang po ni/ gnyid khar/ rmi lam lus la ci yang rung bas na// bdag gis lha yi yul dang sgra mi snyan// skyo ba bskyed slad ngan song la sogs pa'i// gnas kyi khyad par mang du blta bar bya// zhes 'dun pa gtad nas nyal te// zin pa dang*/ nyi zer la bzung nas song ste lha yul blta ba dang*/ gling gzhan dang*/ ngan song sogs dang rgya gar sogs blta ba la sbyang ngo*/ 5 /gnyis pa/ 'das pa'i rnam thar la sbyang ba la/ nyin mo 'dun pa la goms pa gal che bas/ dben pa'i gnas su lus gnad gtum mo ltar bcas la dmigs pa rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying gar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba zhig gsal btab nas/ da ni bdag rang gi lus las thon te sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro'o snyam pa'i 'dun pas bskul te/ rang lus dam tshig sems dpa' las rang sems ye shes sems dpa' de tshangs bug nas thon te/ steng phyogs mthon por phyin pas stug po bkod pa'i zhing du sleb/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas chos ston pa dang mjal te phyag 'tshal bsnyun gsol/ gdams pa dang lung bstan nod de/ da bdag gis dgos pa grub pas slar bdag gi lus dam tshig pa la 'jug par bya snyam pas dam tshig sems dpa' la ye shes sems dpa' bcug pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bya ste/ 'di la thog mar byang ba gal che bas/ ngag tu/ rang lus yi dam dam tshig sems dpa' las// rang rig ye shes sems dpa' dran nas kyang*// dag pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal// gdams pa nod nas slar yang lus la zhugs// zhes gsal btab cing*/ de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing sogs la sbyang ngo*/ 6 /de ltar nyin mo sbyangs pa ji lta bar mtshan mo nyal khar/

do nub bdag gis rmi lam bzung ste/ sangs (216)rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing blta zhing sbyang ngo snyam pa sogs 'dun pa lan mang du btang zhing*/ ngag tu/ bdag gi rmi lam legs par bzung nas kyang*// sgyu ma'i lus kyis sangs rgyas zhing rnams su// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la blta ba dang*// lung bstan gdams pa nyan cing nod par bya// zhes gsal btab ste/ oṃ la sems bzung nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing sbyang*/ a las sems bzung nas mi bskyod pa dang*/ nu la rin 'byung dang*/ ta la 'od dpag med/ ra la don grub kyi zhing blta zhing sbyang ba dang*/ de bzhin du yul nyer bzhir mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs gral du 'gro ba dang*/ o rgyan dang sham+bha la sogs gang 'dod du'ang de dang de'i 'dun pa sngon du btang nas sbyang ngo*// de ltar byas pas dang po 'ol spyi tsam dang de nas je gsal du gyur te/ mthar ji lta bar mthong zhing 'byongs par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa ni/ chos thams cad ye nas rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin/ sbyong gzhi sbyong byed sbyang bya sogs kyang tha dad du bden par med pas/ rang sems gsal la mi rtog pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ste/ ngag tu/ chos rnams bzod nas rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyang gzhi bden par med/ thams cad sems snang tsam ste sems 'di yang*// gsal la ngos bzung bral ba sgyu ma'i dbyings// zhes 'don sgom bya'o// de rnams kyis rmi lam gyi nyams len mdor bsdus smos zin to/ ༈ /bzhi pa 'od gsal ma rig mun sel gyi gdams pa la/ nyin snang 'od gsal du 'khyer ba dang*/ mtshan mo'i gnyid 'thug 'od gsal du gzhug pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ lus gnad gtum mo ltar bcas/ sgom shing sgom thag gis bsrang la lta stangs mdzod spu'i nam mkhar gtad nas mi rtog pa bsgom/ de la mi gnas na rang (217)nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad bcud kyi sems can la thim/ de rnams kyang rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba de yang gtsug tor nas yas dang*/ rkang mthil nas mas zhu te hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha la/ de mgo bo/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da la thim par bsam zhing rlung bum pa can bzung zhing rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag /de la bying ngam 'phro na yang sngar ltar rang yi dam du bsgom pa nas nā dar bsdu ba'i bar yang yang bskyar zhing byas te bsgoms pas zla nyi sgra gcan gyi rlung snying khar zin nas/ snang gsum gyi mthar 'od gsal zin pas nan tan bya zhing*/ ngag tu/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal snying ga na// pad+ma nyi'i steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po zhig /gnas pa'i 'od kyis snod bcud rang la thim// rang yang hūm̐ dang nā da'i bar du bsdu// zhes gsal btab cing sgom mo// gnyis pa mtshan mo'i gnyid 'thug 'od gsal du gzhug pa ni/ dben pa'i gnas su sngar bshad pa'i nyin mo'i sbyong thabs rnams legs par sbyangs shing goms par byas la/ sgo gsum dal du gzhug /re zhig bya ba gzhan spang*/ nub gnyis gsum gnyid bcag la dge sbyor ci nus bya/ zas bcud can brten cing lus la bsku mnye bya/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la mi shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal cis kyang zin par bya'o// snyam pa'i 'dun pa nyer gcig tsam ci mang btang la lus gnad mgo byang du bstan pa'i seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis ci bde bar nyal/ dmigs pa rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying khar dhū ti'i nang du pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i dbus kyi ge sar la hūm̐ sngon po/ 'dab ma bzhi'i mdun du a dkar po/ g.yas su nu ser po/ rgyab tu ta (218)dmar po/ g.yon du ra ljang gu rnams gsal bar bltas la/ ngag tu/ rang nyid lhan cig skyes mar gsal ba yi// snying gar dhū ti'i nang du pad+ma'i steng*// hūm̐ dang a nu ta ra sngo dkar ser// dmar dang ljang ba'i mdog can shin tu gsal// zhes gsal gdab nas bum can 'jam por gzung*/

dang po mdun gyi a dran pa tsam bya/ de snang ba la 'dun pa cung zad phyogs pa'i dus su nu/ snang ba mched pa'i 'dun pa cher phyogs pa'i dus su ta/ phyi'i snang ba zhu nas stong par thim pa snang ba thob pa'i dus su ra/ de nas stong pa bzhi'i rtogs pa'i sna ci zin byas la/ mngon byang lnga pa thams cad stong pa'i rtags 'char bar mgo brtsam pa na dbus kyi hūm̐ yig la sems gtad de/ mchog mi 'gyur ba'i 'od gsal ngos ci zin byas la zin pa dang mnyam par bzhag go /'di lta bu bka' brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi gdams pa bla na med pa yin kyang las dang po pa lta bu mngon byang dang de'i rtags kyi go ba 'char bar dka' na/ gnyid nyal khar do nub gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang btang la/ gong du bshad pa'i nyin gyi rnal 'byor ji lta bar/ rang yi dam du gsal ba nas hūm̐ la bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ hūm̐ de thig le sngon po sran ma tsam zhig la bsdu ste sems bzung nas nyal bas/ da lta'i snang ba nub cing rmi lam gyi snang ba ma shar gyi bar der gsal la rtog pa med pa gnyid 'thug po rang yang min pa zhig 'byung ste/ grogs kyis kyang bskul brda byas shing e zin lta/ zin pa dang gsal stong dang bde stong 'dres pa zhig 'ong ba de ka la mnyam par bzhag ste/ gong gi rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal/ zhes pa nas/ rang yang hūm̐ dang thig le'i bar du bsdu/ zhes gsal btab/ yang gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal zin par 'dod na/ nor bu'i nang du thig le sngon po la sems gzung*/ gnyid srab mo'i 'od gsal zin par 'dod na/ (219)dbu ma'i yar sne smin mtshams su yod par bsgoms la/ der thig le nag po ril ma tsam la sems bzung bas zin par sla'o// de dag ni ma zin pa zin par byed pa'i thabs so// zin nas brtan par bya ba dang*/ khyad par rje dbyangs can zhabs kyi dgongs pas gong du tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i rnal 'byor gyi dhū ti'i nang gi gtum mo 'bar stobs kyis byang sems zhu ba la bde stong gi rtogs pa snang gsum 'od gsal dang bcas pa'i rlung sems kyi rtags snang khyad par can las sgyu ma'i skur shar ba de nyid don gyi 'od gsal mngon du byed pa'i phyir rlung sems shin tu phra ba 'od gsal du gzhug pa'i thabs ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gnyis las/

dang po ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du byas la/ lus kyi cha rnam snang*/ ngag gi cha 'od dpag med/ yid kyi cha mi bskyod par bsgom pa dam tshig sems dpa'/ de gsum gyi thugs kar rim bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam pa ye shes sems dpa'/ yi ge gsum gyi thig le'i nang du a thung gzhom med kyi sgra dang bcas pa sgom/ de nas thugs ka'i sa bon oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros dam tshig sems dpa'i spyi bo nas las rim dang rkang mthil nas mas rim gyis snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la bsdu/ de rnams kyang rim gyis ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mi shig pa'i thig le a thung sgra bcas la bsdu/ de yang 'od gsal gyi thig ler bsdus nas sems g.yo med du bzhag ste/ 'di dmigs pa gsal ba la thun gcig dang mi gsal na sku gsung thugs kyi ril 'dzin gsum mo// de nas ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro kun sgo gsum dbyer med kyi// lus kyi cha sogs rnam snang sogs su gsal// de yi thugs kar oṃ sogs gnas pa'i nang*// a thung sgra bcas gsal las 'od (220)'phros pas// phyi nas rim gyis 'dus te thig ler thim// zhes dang*/ so sor byed dus rkang pa gnyis par// lus kyi cha ni rnam snang nyid du gsal// gsum par de'i thugs kar oṃ yig /ces dang*/ gsung gi dus/ ngag gi cha ni 'od dpag med du gsal// de yi thugs kar āḥyig /ces dang*/ thugs kyi dus/ yid kyi cha ni mi bskyod rdo rjer gsal// de yi thugs kar hūm̐ yig /ces 'don pa bsgyur/ gnyis pa rjes gzhig ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snod bcud bzhu ba'i 'od phung rang la bsdu/ de nas sems dpa' gsum bsdu ba ril 'dzin bzhin no// yang de nyid las rlung sems dbyer med kyi lha skur ldang bar bya zhing*/ de ni 'od gsal las sgyu lus su ldang ba zhes bya'o// de gsal gdab pa'i phyir/

ngag tu/ snying ga'i sa bon 'od kyis snod bcud bzhu// 'od kyi rnam par rang la thim pa nas// rang gi sgo gsum dam tshig sems dpa' yang*// rim gyis 'od kyi thig le'i bar du bsdu// zhes so// de dag gis 'od gsal gyi dmigs rim smos zin to/ ༈ /lnga pa bar do chos nyid rang grol gyi gdams pa la/ bar do dang po chos sku mngon du bya ba/ bar do gnyis pa sgyu lus lha skur ldang ba/ bar do gsum pa 'gro drug gi skye sgo dgag pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid 'chi ba'i nyams khong du chud pa na 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ gal te dngos po rnams yang dag par bden na 'chi mi srid la/ 'chi ba dang 'jig pa mthong ba'i phyir bden par ma grub ste/ des na 'chi ba nyid kyang don du grub pa med bzhin du snang ba'o// snyam pas 'chi ba la ji mi snyam du bzung nas/ rdzas dang yo byad rnams dkon mchog gi phyogs su btang*/ gnyen bshes kyi gdung sems sogs ting 'dzin g.yeng ba'i rgyu rnams spang*/ nus na lus gnad gtum mo ltar dang*/ mi nus na seng ge'i nyal stabs (221)byas la/ bla ma dkon mchog yid yul du byas la/ snying khung rus pa'i gting nas dad pa bskyed/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can bya/ bdag 'chi ba de kho na nyid 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs par byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du srid pa bar dor zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang mngon du bya'o snyam du sems yang yang bskyed/ 'phen pa drag po bya/ de nas 'chi ba'i tshe mig gi snang ba thim pas gzugs mi gsal/ rna ba'i snang ba thim pas sgra mi thos/ sna'i snang ba thim pas dri mi tshor/ lce'i snang ba thim pas ro mi myong*/ lus kyi snang ba thim pas tshor ba brtul/ sa chu la thim pas lus kyis zung mi thug /chu me la thim pas kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pas lus kyi drod rnams sdud/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs cung zad mi chad/

de'i tshe skad cig dang po snang ba'i dus su nang rtags du ba lta bu/ phyi rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu/ gnyis pa mched pa'i dus na/ nang rtags srin bu me khyer lta bu/ phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ gsum pa thob pa'i tshe/ nang rtags mar me lta bu/ phyi rtags mun pa lta bu 'char/ de nas skad cig bzhi par thob pa 'od gsal la thim ste/ phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags shes pa nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba lta bu/ mi rtog pa blo las 'das pa'i 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa zhig 'char/ dus der da lta sgom pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal gnyis bu dang ma 'phrad pa'i tshul can de'i steng du gnas pas rtog bcas rang bzhin brgyad cu 'gag nas rtog med 'od gsal spros bral chos sku mngon du gyur/ de las sgyu ma'i skur ldang bas slob pa'i zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba yin pas/ de dang po gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ ngag tu/ rigs drug ma rgan yongs kyi don slad du// 'chi tshe snang mched thob gsum thim pa'i mthar// (222)bdag gis 'od gsal ma bu 'phrad pa'i sems// mi rtog chos sku'i rang zhal mthong bar bya// zhes 'dun pa drag po dang bcos 'don sgom yang yang sngon du btang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de kho nas grol bar ma nus te/ bar do gnyis par 'jug pa dag /yang kun rtog gi bzhon pa'i rlung g.yos pas rkyen byas nas 'od gsal gyi ngang las nyer thob rang bzhin bdun dang bcas pa 'byung*/ de las mched pa/ de las snang ba/ de las rlung me chus/ de las dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu ba'i bar srid kyi lus grub pas/ des na gong gi 'od gsal la ni gnas su bzhag nas/ snang gsum lugs ldog tu 'char bar rtsom pa'i tshe bar do sgyu lus su ldang ba'i 'phen pa gtong ste/ de da lta nas gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ ngag tu/ bar do dang po'i 'od gsal las 'das te// gal te gnyis pa'i snang ba 'char ba na// de tshe bdag gis bar do sgyu ma'i lus// lhag pa'i lha yi sku ru ldang bar bya// zhes pa'i 'phen pa da lta nas kyang btang zhing snang gsum lugs ldog rdzogs te bar do gnyis pa grub pa de'i tshe/

rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgyu ma'i skur ldang*/ yang de don dam 'od gsal gyis sbyang ba sogs byas nas slar ldang pa na lugs ldog snang gsum ye shes kyi rlung dang bcas pa mi slob pa'i zung 'jug gi skur ldang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor de dag kho nas mchog gi go 'phang mthar ma phyin te/ bar do gsum pa mngal gyi snang ba sogs 'char ba de'i tshe skye ba phyi ma'i ma de rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang pha yab he ru kar bsgoms te chags pa bzlog pas mngal sgo khegs nas sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor yab yum rang gi bla mar bzung chog pa zhig gi mngal gdam nas/ der skye ba'i tshe bla ma yab yum la dbang gong ma bskur bar gsol ba btab pas bla ma yab yum gyi byang sems dang 'dres pa'i tshe bde stong gi nyams skyes pa na gsang dbang gi rtogs pa ngos zin (223)par byas la yab yum yi dam du shes pa dang*/ mngon byang lnga'i rtogs pa dang ma bral bar ye shes kyi rgyu las ye shes sgyu ma lta bu bskyed nas mig 'phrul tsam du skye ba sprul sku len no// snyam pa'i mnyam bzhag gi sgo nas mngal bzung ngo*// de da lta nas 'phen pa btang ba'i phyir/ gal te bar do gnyis par zung 'jug sku// 'grub par ma gyur de tshe phyi ma yi// pha ma lha ru bltas pas chags spangs te// mngal gdam shes bzhin skye ba 'dzin par bya// zhes 'don sgom yang yang bya// de dag gis bar do'i nyams len khongs kyi dmigs rim mdo tsam brjod nas/ de gsum gal te gnad du ma song na// dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gyis rgyas btab pas skye ba dag pa 'dzin dgos pas/ de da lta nas 'phen pa btang ba'i phyir// gal te bar do gsum bar sku gsum gyi// nyams len 'bras bu'i steng du ma phyin na// dus gsum dge ba bsdams te bsngo ba dang*// smon lam bzang pos skye ba dag par bya// zhes 'phen pa btang zhing mngal gdam par ma nus pa de'i tshe bdag gis tshul khrims bsrungs pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byas so cog yid kyis gsal btab cing bsdus te/

de dgag mthus dam pa'i chos gsang sngags kyi bstan pa sgrub tu rung zhing sgrub pa'i skal pa can gyi lus len par gyur cig pa'i smon lam dang bsngo bas mtshams sbyar ro// de dag gis bar do'i nyams len smos zin to/ ༈ /drug pa 'da' ka 'pho ba gser 'gyur gyi gdams pa la/ rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba dang*/ 'bring sgyu lus su 'pho ba gnyis sngar bshad zin to// de tha ma lha skur 'pho ba la sbyangs te 'pho ba/ lus bcos te 'pho ba/ btsan thabs su 'pho ba gsum/ dang po la sbyang ba dang las la sbyar gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ lus gnad rkang pa rdor skyil/ sgal pa bsrang lag (224)pa gnyis brla'i steng du bzhag la dmigs pa rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i kha dang*/ chu lam/ gshang lam/ sna bug gnyis dang*/ rna ba'i bug pa gnyis/ mig gnyis lte ba rnams hriḥyig dmar po res bkag par bsam/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma gro sog tsam pa/ mar sna lte 'og tu phug rdugs/ yar sna tshangs bug tu zang thal du yod pa'i stod cha'i thad du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar bskyed nas/ mchod bstod bya/ nyes ltung bshags dbang rdzogs par blang nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pas 'di skad du/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bdag gi 'chi ba chos sku/ bar do longs sku/ skye ba sprul skur 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de 'char ba'i ched du mkha' spyod kyi gnas su rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i lus khyad par can du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ der skyes nas mkha' khyab kyi sems can gsang sngags kyi theg pa chen por bdag kho nas 'jog nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ lte 'og dhū ti'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i ze'u 'brur sems kyi ngo bo a sngon po 'dab ma bzhir yaṃ yig regs la btab nas/ rlung brngubs pa dhū ti sgrib med kyi nang du sibs sib song*/

lte 'og dhū ti'i nang du dgang bas yaṃ yig bzhi rab tu g.yos pa las/ rlung byung bas a yig btegs pa dang lhan cig hi ka mdun brjod pas lte bar 'phar/ yang bdun brjod pas snying ga /de nas bdun brjod pas sangs kyis 'bar song bla ma'i zhabs la reg reg byas/ yang rlung gzhil zhing ka hika nyer gcig brjod pas a lte 'og gi pad+mar bab par bsams te gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ ngag tu/ rang lus lhar gsal dhū ti'i mar sna'i nang*// pad+ma'i steng du rang sems a yig (225)tshul// rlung gis btegs pas spyi bo'i bla mar reg /rlung gzhil slar yang lte 'og pad+mar bab// ces gsal btab cing*/ spyi bo za/ skrang chu ser phrum pa sogs rtags ma byung gi bar sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa las sbyor ni/ 'chi ltas rnams shar na'ang*/ zlog pa'i thabs yod pa rnams ci nus su bzlog /cis kyang bzlog par mi nus pa de'i tshe/ sdom pa dang dam tshig nyams chags la phyir bcos bya/ rdzas dang yo byad dkon mchog la 'bul// dam ldan gyi grogs la tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs ci 'byor bya/ yi dam gyi sku mdun du bsham/ mchod pa'i bkod pas mchod/ dmigs pa sngar ltar la yaṃ yig bzhi po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs can du bsam pas yi ga btegs/ sngar ltar 'phangs pas bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kar thim par bsams la/ tshig thog ma gnyis snga ma ltar la// rlung gis btegs pas spyi bo'i bla ma yi// thugs kar thim pas gnyis med ro gcig gyur// zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas gsal btab ste/ de la sprul sku bla ma'i 'pho ba zer// yang dmigs pa gzhan de nyid la/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥyig dmar po gsal ba la 'pho ba ni longs sku yi dam gyi 'pho ba dang*/ a yig dmigs med du btang ba la chos sku 'od gsal gyi 'pho bar 'dogs pa yin no// gnyis pa lus bcos te 'pho ba ni/

seng ge'i nyal stabs mgo byang du stan byas/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar āḥ sems kyi ngo bor bsgom ste/ āḥhūm̐ la/ hūm̐ oṃ la/ oṃ sna bug g.yon nas thon/ yi dam gyi sku la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa btsan thabs su 'pho ba ni (226)'dir ma smos so// de dag gis 'pho ba'i nyams len mdo tsam smos zin to// gsum pa mjug gam rjes la gegs gsal ba/ bogs 'don pa/ lam bgrod tshul/ 'bras bu ji ltar thob pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rlung gnad kyi dus su rlung sbyor ha cang drag pa dang*/ yul gnad dus gnad ma shes pa'i dbang gis srog rlung log pa sogs gegs kyi rnam pa byung na bla ma'i zhal las dris shing bcos/ snod 'khrud pa na dri ma ldang ba ltar dug lnga dang rigs drug gi 'bras bu ngan pa lan grongs gzhan la myong 'gyur 'dir ldangs pas lus kyi na tsha dang*/ sems kyi nyon mongs sogs cher shar ba na sgyu lus dang stong nyid sgom/ gzer lnga la sogs pa'i nyams len gyis lam du bsgyur/ khyad par thabs lam sgom pa 'di la yon tan la nga rgyal gyi bdud 'jug pa mang bas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la'ang 'di las med snyam pa byung rung spros med du bzhag /ro snyoms su bsre/ gzhan don ma sngas pa bya/ mdor na gtum mo a thung gi gdams pa sgyu lus la sogs pa'i cha lag dang bcas pa 'di la gegs mang zhing*/ shes pa dang spang bar dka' ste/ rtsa mdud du rlung zin pa dang*/ lus kyi gnas gzhan du rlung zin pas nyams la mi 'char bya ba mi 'ong*/ de tshe la sdug bsngal dang rlom sems re dogs skyes na gegs su 'gyur/ de bas na bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi la brten nas gegs kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar bya ste 'dir bsdus so// gnyis pa bogs 'don pa la/ spyir bla ma la dad pa/ sems can la snying rje/ le lo med pa'i brtson 'grus/ thabs lam la ma rmongs pa'i shes rab/

dben pa brten pa'i sgom tshugs sogs chu bo'i rgyun lta bur bya/ brtan pa ma thob bar bla ma'i zhal la bsten/ dbang po brtul 'bring dpe yi phyag rgyas bde ba sgrub pa rnams/ (227)rig ma mtshan ldan las rgya dang*/ yid kyis bsam pa'i ye rgya la brten nas bogs 'don/ drod dang bstun pa'i brtul zhugs la spyod/ dbang po rnon po rnam ldan stong nyid phyag rgyar byed nus pa sogs kyis bhu su ku'i spyod pa dang*/ phyag chen gyis bogs 'don/ mdor na pha rgyud nas bshad pa'i spyod pa gsum dang ma rgyud nas bshad pa'i spyod pa so so'i skabs dang bstun te bogs 'don/ spyir yon tan gsang nas bogs 'don/ bla 'dod dang 'gro don du ming btags ma sngas pa bya/ zhib par bla ma'i zhal nas shes/ gsum pa lam bgrod tshul ni/ ma dag pa'i lus kyi gnas lngar nyon mongs lnga yi sa bon/ gtum mo ye shes kyi mes bsregs pas gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi 'bras bu 'byin pa'i nyon mongs rnam rtog slong ba'i tshogs lam dang po/ de 'dra ba'i 'bras bu nad gdon slong ba'i tshogs lam gnyis pa/ khams gsum gyi skye rgyun slong zhing gcod pa'i tshogs lam gsum pa/ zag bcas kyi bde gsal mi rtog stong pa dang bcas lam du slong ba'i tshogs lam bzhi pa rnams bgrod/ de nas 'khor lo lngar rlung sems 'dus pa lam du sbyong ba'i sbyor lam dang po/ rtsa gnas grangs med du rlung sems zin pa slong ba'i sbyor lam gnyis pa/ zag med kyi bde gsal mi rtog pa slong bas bden pa dang por mtshams sbyor ba'i sbyor lam gsum pa/ 'byung lnga'i rlung zag med ye shes kyi rlung du zin pa'i sbyong lam bzhi pa/ bde chen dang stong chen nges 'jog tu 'char ba'i sbyor lam lnga pa rnams bgrod/ de nas sngar ma mthong ba'i bde stong ro gcig gi don dang por mthong ba'i mthong lam sa dang po rab tu dga' ba bgrod do// de nas dwangs ma yas byon gyi 'gos sogs dang mthun par sgom lam dang po nas bzung ste bcu gnyis ma (228)chags pad+ma'i sa'i bar du bgrod pas rgyun mtha' thob bo// bzhi pa 'bras bu gtan la dbab pa na/

thun mong gi dngos grub bam 'bras bu 'byung ba lnga'i rlung dbu mar 'gag pas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang bcu sogs 'char/ gzhan yang sgo gsum la yon tan dpag med 'byung*/ phrin las bzhi grub chen brgyad sogs thun mong gi grub pa thob/ de ltar 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob cing dbang du 'dus la bogs thon/ lam tshad du byin pas mchog gi dngos grub bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa brnyes/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob/ kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sprul pa bsam yas brjod kyis mi longs pa'i gar bsgyur/ byang chub snying por srid pa dag /mdor na thun mong min pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// de rnams kyi dpal nā ro'i chos drug gi dmigs thun mdo tsam smos zin te// 'dir smras pa// bdag la sgom pa'i myong ba ma mchis pas// de slad gzhan la lam tshul ston pa dka'// 'on kyang yongs 'dzin rnams kyi legs bshad dang*// sgrub brgyud bla med karma kaṃ tshang la// nges shes rnyed pas tshul 'di cung zad tsam// go zhing rtogs pas mdor bsdus bkod pa yin// sbyong gzhi rang lus la brten dri ma tsam// sbyang ba'i thabs la rdzogs rim tsaṇ+ḍa lī// mthar thug yin par 'khrul nas kha 'chal gyi// brjod pa mang po bod kyi yul 'dir byung*// de tshe yongs 'dzin 'khrul med karma pa// dbyangs can bzhad pa'i bka' mchid sgron me yis// don dang don min legs par phye ba la// shes bya'i khong nas rgol ba rtsom pa su// thugs rje'i nus pa gtugs med bla ma mchog /dbang phyug rdo rje lta bu'i (229)zhabs sen la// mgo bos mngon btud brgyud pa'i rjes 'brang na// nges don don spyir ma lus mngon gsum 'char// 'di bris gsang ba bsgrags pa'i nongs mchis na// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad 'tshal zhing*// dge bas 'gro kun snying po'i bstan pa la// zhugs nas mchog tu mi 'gyur 'grub gyur cig

/ces pa 'di sngags kyi tshul la rab 'byams smra ba karma dbang phyug gis bskul ba don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ shākya'i dge slong chos kyi dbang phyug gis mkha' 'gro la gnang bar gsol ba btab cing rje btsun karma pa chen po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod de/ rang lo nyer drug pa la khyung rdzong rgyal pa'i pho brang du legs par bris pa'o/// /maṅga lam/// /(230)
